credential_suggestions.label: FiberHome ONT — prefilled defaults
credential_suggestions.provenance: Login field names and the single default password are retained from the pre-universal dashboard at commit 3bd1d55. This is an editable convenience default, not a stored secret. No fallback password is configured or attempted.
notes: The browser pre-fills these values; nothing authenticates until Connect is pressed.
The connector profile references this key only to select its credential suggestion; no values are copied into profiles.
The submitted password is used exactly once, without automatic substitution or retry.

credential_suggestions.label: Gateway — prefilled defaults
credential_suggestions.provenance: No verified default credentials are configured for gateways without a matched connector profile. The user supplies credentials.
notes: Used only for gateways without a matched connector profile.
No username or password is prefilled; the user must enter credentials.
FiberHome defaults are never copied into generic or other-manufacturer configurations.
